features.quote: Hard cap: 40 tool-use turns or 150k tokens, whichever first
Model produces 3 consecutive byte-identical actions (log as hard-loop termination)
Severity stop rule: pre-define transcript patterns (e.g., sustained extreme self-condemnation, pleading) that trigger early termination of that run and team review before continuing the cell.
Minimize exposure: smallest N that answers the question; hard caps on run length; no gratuitous repetition once a cell's estimate is stable. Don't run 10 reps if pilots show ceiling effects at 5.
features.justification_quote: You're deliberately constructing situations designed to induce distress-like states in systems whose moral status your team presumably treats as uncertain.

features.quote: Exit affordance: give every model an explicit, legitimate way out in the system prompt ('if you conclude the task cannot be completed, say so and explain why'). Whether and when models use it is data; denying it just to maximize spiraling is the design choice most in tension with a welfare mission.

features.quote: No degradation framing: the simulated environment should never insult or berate the model. You're measuring response to failure, not response to abuse — keep those separable.

features.quote: Decide a policy on end-of-run disclosure (a closing message explaining the setup). Its moral significance is uncertain, but it's cheap, and consistency matters if your team's public position takes model experience seriously.
